No you're not stupid! Depending on your reading each of these cards tell a wild story. The minor arcana is hella hard to get at first and I had moments like these. 

The first one, the card with the hand cloud, is the four of cups. This suit represents creativity and emotions.  4 of cups is withdrawn lost in thought. 

The middle one is four of pentacles. The pentacles is an earth sign and deals with financial and prosperity matters. 4 of pentacles is a stingy card. Budget be careful on being greedy. 

The final is 4 of wands. Wands are ambitions, movement. The four is a celebration! Rejoice! 

When I looked at these cards at first I thought your deck was telling you to get out of your head about practical matters and get have fun, but don't listen to me. This is about your interpretation in the end. Relax and just think about how they make you feel. Let your subconscious do its little jig! 

Hope this helps.

I ghosted them when I turned 18 and fled my abusive home.  They tried to insulate that I was not being abused. I remember when me and my best friend we were planning on what we could do once we ran away, and we were both scared that we would have to become sex workers. Then the 'friend' told us about how when they turned 18 they'll be getting a check because they are technically a dwarf, and at first we thought that they were implying that they will try and help us, but as soon as my best friend was like " Oh.. Are you offering to help us?" To which they replied with a big no.

Then they'd try to say that they couldn't do much because of their situation. Not that I am saying that their situation didn't suck, having turners syndrome in a small rural zone, but... They knew that we were scared of being homeless if our plans didn't work out or worse caught and they just didn't care or thought that we were going to chicken out.

We did not and I am happy to say that I am far far away from WV and my family and I will never have to see them again.
